map.输入广告展示量与点击量，计算点击率（CTR），衡量广告创意与定向的吸引力，用于广: Enter ad impressions and clicks to compute click-through rate (CTR), measuring the appeal of the creative and targeting, for evaluating and optimizing ad delivery.
map.评估素材/标题吸引力，算点击占展示比。: Evaluate creative/title appeal by computing clicks as a share of impressions.
map.由 CTR 与花费反推 CPC、CPM、CPA。: Back out CPC, CPM and CPA from CTR and spend.
map.多素材 A/B 按 CTR 选最优。: A/B test multiple creatives and pick the best by CTR.
map.：展示 100000、点击 3000 → CTR=3%；花费 6000 → CP: : 100,000 impressions, 3,000 clicks -> CTR = 3%; spend 6,000 -> CPM = 60, CPC = 2; 100 conversions -> CPA = 60 CNY.
map.：素材 A CTR=2%、素材 B CTR=4%，同样展示量 B 多一倍点击，应: : creative A CTR = 2%, creative B CTR = 4%; with the same impressions B gets twice the clicks, so roll out B fully.
map.行业差异大：搜索广告常 3–5%，信息流 1–3%，超 5% 优秀。同行业同版位: Industries differ a lot: search ads are often 3-5%, feeds 1-3%, and above 5% is excellent. Only compare within the same industry and placement.
map.可能是标题党，点击与落地页预期不符，应同步看转化率而非只追 CTR。: It may be clickbait, where the click does not match the landing page's promise; watch the conversion rate too instead of chasing CTR alone.
